data.name: Expert Extraction Pilot
data.description: Expert Extraction Pilot is a Booster in Helldivers 2. When equipped, the extraction timer will be decreased, allowing for the Helldivers' squad to extract from a mission at a quicker rate. This booster does not affect missions where the Extraction Shuttle is immediately called in and lands after a mission is completed.
data.effect: Lowers the time it takes for the extraction shuttle to reach the extraction beacon.
